adoration.text: Adoration room open 6:00am to 10:15pm daily (closed every Wednesday from 10:00am to 12:00 noon for cleaning).

confession.text: 30 mins before Weekend Mass in the Main Church.

devotions.text: Liturgy of the Word for Children every 2nd & 4th Sunday of the month at the 10.30am Mass.
Christian Meditation every Wed at 8pm in St John/St Luke room.
Divine Mercy Devotion every Tue at 6.45pm in the Main Church.
Rosary Prayers Mon to Fri at 5.15pm in the Main Church.
